description: This Java source file defines a class `MessageOnlyLogFilter` which implements the `LogNode` interface. Its purpose is to filter log output to only display message content by removing other metadata such as tags and priorities. It can be linked into a chain of log nodes to process log messages sequentially.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter that outputs only the message part of a log message, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a LogNode to chain subsequent logs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, forwarding only the message (msg) to the next LogNode in the chain with default priority.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain for log forwarding.
